query: I just spent the whole afternoon baking chocolate chip cookies for my neighbor's birthday, the recipe I found online said to use brown butter and it made the whole house smell so warm and sweet. I also finally got around to repotting the pothos plant that's been sitting on my windowsill for months, it had grown so many new roots that it was basically bursting out of its old plastic pot. Oh and my cat just knocked over my mug of iced tea earlier, I had to rush to wipe up the spill before it seeped into the carpet, what a little troublemaker he is.
